title: MeetingAdjournedData
description: data of meeting.adjourned (ADR-0028). The room closed, once (MR-05). actor is the convener when reason is person, otherwise system (the idle sweeper, the cap check, Pause all or Stop all, the access check); target is the lead. turns is the number of meeting.asked in the room and credits_spent the sum of its meeting.replied credits (MR-08). A room open at Pause all or Stop all is adjourned (paused) before world.paused is written.
